data.body:
[P2] Require progress from the original healthy peer

This accepts a heartbeat from any invocation of the peer, and the subsequent checks only require successful execution completion and one `peer-after` body. If victim cleanup interrupts the original peer and the service retries it while its gate remains held, that retry can satisfy every check. The early-return cases therefore pass despite disrupting the companion they should preserve. Carry the original peer request ID into this helper and require its post-boundary heartbeat, `peer-after` progress, and successful return. Add a negative control where only a retry makes progress.
